fieldValues.title: 12. A framework (proposal, not a ruling)
fieldValues.thinking_reached: One spine: the handbook flow. Six classifications, each owned once: (1) kind of item (epic, story, work item, bug, RFC, ADR, decision); (2) value and order, derived; (3) effort, one size scale and one complexity scale; (4) state, one set (decision f58db200 already points here); (5) authority, mode × door, already ruled for every repo (949ae72d); (6) route, domain to group. Repo-local variants keep the framework and add their own forms: srs keeps the Doors and the RFC process, srs-rust keeps ADRs, muDemocracy.org drops MECHANICAL / JUDGEMENT / OWNER for the shared authority rule. Bugs need no problem (owner ruling, 2026-10-25).
fieldValues.tensions: - Doors and ADRs are decision forms, not work classifications, so they fit the framework only as local variants of 'decide'.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: - Who owns the framework: the clerk handbook, or a spec-level decision?
fieldValues.next_action: Quick wins from systems 2, 3, 4 and 8; then planning for 6, 7 and 9.
